title: KDM5C-regulated SIX5 promotes glioblastoma progression through transcriptional activation of UBE2C and enhancement of the Warburg effect.
authors: Li, Zhang; Wang, Nan; Liu, Defeng; Wang, Yunshan; Li, Haiying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KDM5C-SIX5-UBE2C轴在胶质母细胞瘤中的致癌作用，涉及SIX5转录因子结合UBE2C启动子，但核心是肿瘤生物学与Warburg效应，无AI/物理模拟方法，仅湿实验验证，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Gliomas are the most common primary malignant tumors of the adult central nervous system, characterized by rapid growth, high recurrence rates, and limited response to standard treatments, with median survival under 15 months. The SIX transcription factor family has been implicated in tumor development, but the role and regulatory mechanism of SIX5 in glioblastoma (GBM) remain unclear. This study systematically investigates the biological function of SIX5 and its regulatory network in GBM. Differential expression and weighted gene co-expression network analyses of GSE4290 and GSE50161 datasets, combined with machine learning algorithms including LASSO, identified SIX5 as a core candidate gene. Functional enrichment analyses and evaluation using TCGA and UALCAN databases revealed that SIX5 is highly expressed in GBM and associated with poor prognosis. Single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics showed enrichment of SIX5 in the tumor core and in astrocyte-like and stem cell-like subsets at the invasion front. In vitro, U87 and U251 cells with lentivirus-mediated SIX5 knockdown or overexpression were assessed for proliferation, migration, invasion, apoptosis, and colony formation. SIX5 knockdown significantly inhibited proliferation, migration, invasion, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and tumorigenicity, while promoting apoptosis. Mechanistically, KDM5C positively regulates SIX5, which directly binds the UBE2C promoter to activate its transcription, enhancing AKT/mTOR signaling and promoting aerobic glycolysis via upregulation of GLUT1, HK2, PGK1, and LDHA. Rescue experiments showed that UBE2C overexpression partially restored malignant phenotypes under SIX5 downregulation. In vivo xenograft studies confirmed that the KDM5C-SIX5-UBE2C axis drives GBM growth. In conclusion, SIX5 functions as a critical oncogenic driver in GBM, regulated by KDM5C and promoting tumor progression through UBE2C-mediated activation of AKT/mTOR signaling and glycolytic reprogramming. The KDM5C-SIX5-UBE2C regulatory axis represents a potential prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target in glioblastoma.
abstract_zh: 胶质瘤是成人中枢神经系统最常见的原发性恶性肿瘤，其特征为快速生长、高复发率以及对标准治疗反应有限，中位生存期不足15个月。SIX转录因子家族已被涉及肿瘤发展，但SIX5在胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）中的作用及调控机制仍不清楚。本研究系统探讨了SIX5在GBM中的生物学功能及其调控网络。对GSE4290和GSE50161数据集的差异表达和加权基因共表达网络分析，结合包括LASSO在内的机器学习算法，将SIX5确定为核心候选基因。功能富集分析及使用TCGA和UALCAN数据库的评估显示，SIX5在GBM中高表达，并与不良预后相关。单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组学显示，SIX5在肿瘤核心及侵袭前沿的星形胶质细胞样和干细胞样亚群中富集。在体外，对慢病毒介导的SIX5敲低或过表达的U87和U251细胞进行了增殖、迁移、侵袭、凋亡和集落形成评估。SIX5敲低显著抑制了增殖、迁移、侵袭、上皮-间质转化和致瘤性，同时促进凋亡。机制上，KDM5C正向调控SIX5，后者直接结合UBE2C启动子以激活其转录，增强AKT/mTOR信号传导，并通过上调GLUT1、HK2、PGK1和LDHA促进有氧糖酵解。拯救实验表明，在SIX5下调条件下，UBE2C过表达部分恢复了恶性表型。体内异种移植研究证实，KDM5C-SIX5-UBE2C轴驱动GBM生长。总之，SIX5作为GBM中的关键致癌驱动因子，受KDM5C调控，并通过UBE2C介导的AKT/mTOR信号激活和糖酵解重编程促进肿瘤进展。KDM5C-SIX5-UBE2C调控轴代表了胶质母细胞瘤中潜在的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。
